facts.en: Completed a BA in Organizational Studies at Fictional Institute D097 in 2021.
facts.zh: 2021 年在虚构院校 D097 完成组织研究文学学士学位。

facts.en: Worked as a procedures documentation assistant at Fictional Association D097 from 2022-01 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-01 至 2026-08 在虚构协会 D097 担任流程文件助理。

facts.en: Maintained policy-review calendars and collected comments from designated process owners.
facts.zh: 维护政策审阅日历，并收集指定流程负责人的意见。

facts.en: Tracked version numbers, review dates and approval status in a controlled spreadsheet.
facts.zh: 在受控电子表格跟踪版本号、审阅日期及审批状态。

facts.en: With the operations lead, consolidated 64 comments on a travel-expense procedure draft during 2025-04.
facts.zh: 在 2025-04 与运营负责人合作，整合出行费用流程草稿的 64 条意见。

facts.en: The team assigned 58 of those 64 comments to response owners and left 6 pending clarification; this was review coordination, not policy approval.
facts.zh: 团队为其中 64 条意见的 58 条指定答复负责人，6 条待澄清；这是审阅协调，而非政策审批。

facts.en: Formatted draft text and checked cross-references; authorized policy owners determined substance and signed approval.
facts.zh: 整理草稿格式并检查交叉引用；获授权政策负责人决定实质内容并签字审批。

facts.en: Coordinated distribution of an approved visitor-access procedure in 2026-02 after receiving signed authorization.
facts.zh: 在收到签字授权后，于 2026-02 协调分发获批访客进入流程。

facts.en: The candidate’s distribution role did not confer authority to approve the procedure or interpret legal obligations.
facts.zh: 候选人的分发职责不赋予审批流程或解释法律义务的权限。

facts.en: Drafted a remote-work FAQ outline in 2026-05; it remained under review and was not issued as policy.
facts.zh: 2026-05 起草远程工作常见问题提纲；仍在审查中，未作为政策发布。

facts.en: Separated draft and approved folders and withdrew superseded copies only on owner instruction.
facts.zh: 将草稿及获批文件夹分开，仅按负责人指示撤除过期副本。

facts.en: At the 2025-10 review peak, tracked 8 procedures; the normal 2026-08 list contained 4.
facts.zh: 在 2025-10 审阅高峰期跟踪 8 份流程；2026-08 常规清单有 4 份。

facts.en: Completed a 2024-11 plain-language editing course using fictional policy examples, not legal or compliance certification.
facts.zh: 2024-11 使用虚构政策示例完成通俗语言编辑课程，并非法律或合规认证。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Bookbinding Circle V097 from 2023-04 to 2023-09 on weekends while employed.
facts.zh: 2023-04 至 2023-09 任职期间，周末在虚构装帧社团 V097 志愿服务。

facts.en: For the circle, assembled tool-care instruction sheets supplied by the organizer, not organizational policies.
facts.zh: 为该社团整理组织者提供的工具保养说明页，而非组织政策。

facts.en: Created a personal illustrated index of fictional gardens in 2020 unrelated to policy work.
facts.zh: 2020 年创建个人虚构花园插画索引，与政策工作无关。

facts.en: Enjoys assembling wooden puzzles as a hobby.
facts.zh: 以拼装木质谜题为爱好。

facts.en: A draft CV claims approved 8 policies, but the register shows 8 tracked procedures with approvals owned by designated managers.
facts.zh: 一份简历草稿称批准 8 项政策，但登记表显示为跟踪 8 份流程，审批由指定经理负责。

facts.en: Recorded questions about ambiguous wording and referred them to the policy owner rather than giving independent advice.
facts.zh: 记录对含糊措辞的问题，并转交政策负责人，而非独立提供建议。

facts.en: Maintained an approval-evidence reference for every distributed final version.
facts.zh: 为每个分发的最终版本维护审批证据引用。
